How buying works

From order to live

  1. Choose a position above. Create a free vendor account with your work email; we send you a sign-in link.
  2. Pick the page. In the portal, choose the category shortlist or alternatives page you want; the position you chose is highlighted if it's free there.
  3. Add your product and confirm. Enter your product's name and website and accept the advertiser terms. You can pay by card or bank transfer.
  4. We review your product. It shows as "In editorial review" until we've written its review. Your paid time starts the day it goes live.
Cancelling

Refunds and renewals

Plans renew every month or year until you cancel; a cancelled plan stays live until the end of the period you paid for. Every payment can be refunded in full within 14 days, no questions asked. See the refund policy and advertiser terms.

A position changes where your product appears on a page. It doesn't change its score or our review. Questions: vendors@vettlo.com.
